Wallet / Claim a reward
Claim a pool win from the Wallet (Spec 015 §5.2a). The Wallet shows one profile, so every win listed belongs to that profile and is paid to that profile's wallet; nothing is chosen or redirected.
A claim is one action on one win. With one win, the Rewards card's Claim opens it. With several, each win is its own row with its own Claim.
A palm scan is asked for only when the account's palm scan is missing or out of date. When it is current, Claim asks for nothing more. Each claim is checked by the server by itself; nothing claims several wins at once. The sheet says "You need a palm scan before you can claim." and the button is "Scan palm"; the verification page itself names the Very app, since that is where the person needs it.
Coming back from a palm scan opens the Wallet on the profile that earned the win, with that win in view, whichever profile was showing before. The app resumes the win but does not switch to its profile, so the result can be hidden; that is a defect to fix in code.
Claimed is not paid. After a claim is accepted the win shows Claimed while the profile's wallet is set up, while it is sending, and while a failed send is retried; it shows Paid only when the payment is confirmed. At Paid the wallet's balance is read again and the payment is in it; the reward amount is never added on top, which would count it twice. A stalled payment is retried against the same claim and never asks for another scan.
On hold means the claim could not be completed and the amount is held; it is never shown as a success. A claim refused for a missing or stale palm scan leaves the win unclaimed, with Claim still there.
Royalties, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12: they will need a palm scan like every other claim, but they are not relevant until paid songs or dances exist, so nothing is drawn or built for them now. When they arrive, Spec 015 §5.2a, which covers pool winnings only, needs amending.
Phone: claim a reward. Something to claim; Claim with a current palm scan; the scan sheet when the scan is missing or out of date; waiting for Very; claimed and sending; on hold. Then several wins as separate rows, and one win's row in each state after claiming

The five rows above match these server states, top to bottom: recipient_pending; pending or submitted; failed_retrying; confirmed; subject_conflict. A claim refused for a missing or stale palm scan is none of these: the win stays unclaimed with Claim available.

Built sequence, kept: Claim on a win that needs a palm check goes to the verification page. Very's own panel shows a code for the phone, then a processing state. Continue returns to the Wallet, and the claim for that same win carries on by itself. There is no second Claim press, and no other win is claimed.
The return must land on the profile that earned the win; today the app resumes the win without switching to its profile, which is the defect recorded on this sheet's caption.
After claiming, the dialog closes and the win is a row under Activity, with the same states as the phone. Several wins are separate rows, each with its own Claim.

The app has all of these states on its verification page with other words ("ceremony"); these words are the proposal. A failed or closed check never claims anything and never loses the win. Proposed, not built: showing the code inside the Claim dialog, so the person never leaves the Wallet. It would need Very's panel embedded there and every state on this row inside the dialog; it is not drawn as a screen until that is decided to be worth building. The phone uses the same page; there the panel hands over to the Very app.
